name: Span-Buffer Ray-Casting
definition: A hybrid volume rendering method that changes traversal order from object-then-image to image-then-object to overcome deficiencies in prior methods while maintaining full utilization of image and object space coherencies.
summary: Span-Buffer Ray-Casting is a hybrid volume rendering algorithm for unstructured grids that uses image-then-object traversal to enable early ray termination and maintain space coherencies.
